sentences.text: The appeal in MFA No.22968/2012 is filed by the claimant challenging the judgment and award dated NC: 2023:KHC-D:13461 27.02.2012, in MVC No.1111/2010, passed by the Prl. Senior Civil Judge and Addl. MACT, Belagavi, seeking enhancement of compensation, whereas, MFA CROB No.858/2013 in MFA No.22968/2012 is filed by the KSRTC questioning involvement of the bus in the accident.

2. It is brief case of the claimant that he is being a Police Constable after completion of duty, to go to his native village has come to KSRTC bus stand, Belagavi, and he was waiting for the bus; at that time a KSRTC bus dashed to the claimant in which accident the claimant sustained fracture injuries.

Therefore, he filed a claim petition and the tribunal has awarded compensation of Rs.75,000/-
fastening liability on the KSRTC to pay compensation.

3. Heard the arguments and perused the material placed before the Court.
4.
The accident is taken place on 07.03.2010 at 04.30 p.m.
The complaint is lodged on 08.03.2010.
The NC: 2023:KHC-D:13461 medical evidence on record proves that the claimant sustained fracture to the right hand.

After the accident he went to his native place and after swelling on the right hand,
on the next day on 08.03.2010 he was admitted to KLE hospital, Belagavi.

Therefore, it cannot be said that there is delay in lodging the complaint and also cannot be suspected the injuries sustained in the accident just because he was admitted to the hospital on 08.03.2010.
Therefore, from the complaint averments and medical records i.e., wound certificate and case sheet, it shows that the claimant was hit by bus on 07.03.2010.
Further more, the Investigating Officer has filed the charge sheet against the driver of the bus.
Therefore all this evidence on record proves that the KSRTC bus was involved and caused the accident to the claimant.
Therefore involvement of bus and accident caused are proved.
5. The claimant is a Police Constable.
He was got reimbursement of the medical expenses and hospital charges.

The tribunal has awarded compensation of NC: 2023:KHC-D:13461 Rs.25,000/-
towards pain and suffering, Rs.10,000/- towards medical and ancillary expenses and Rs.40,000/-
towards loss of amenities.

Considering the overall facts and circumstances and injuries sustained,
and also considering the factors that the claimant must have spent some considerable amount towards incidental expenses like traveling, attendant charges, food, nourishment, etc., therefore, it is just and proper to enhance the compensation by another Rs.25,000/- in addition to what has been awarded by the tribunal along with interest at the rate of 6% p.a.
6.
The KSRTC shall deposit the compensation within eight weeks from the date of receipt of certified copy of this judgment.

sentences.text:
In the result, I proceed to pass the following:
ORDER i) The appeal in MFA No.22968/2012 filed by the claimant is allowed in part.
NC: 2023:KHC-D:13461 ii) The cross objection MFA CROB No.858/2013 filed by the KSRTC is dismissed.
iii) The judgment and award dated 27.02.2012, in MVC No.1111/2010, passed by the Prl. Senior Civil Judge and Addl. MACT, Belagavi, stands modified.

iv) The claimant is entitled for enhanced compensation of Rs.25,000/- along with interest at the rate of 6% p.a. from the date of petition till realization, in addition what has been awarded by the tribunal.
 v) The amount in deposit shall be transmitted to the tribunal.
 vi) The entire amount including the amount awarded by the tribunal shall be released in favour of the claimant.
vii) No order as to costs.
NC: 2023:KHC-D:13461 viii) Draw award accordingly.

SD/-
